reviews.x: I have very long, thick hair that is stick straight - literally zero curl in it. I have tried for years to master the art of curling with a flat iron and after purchasing three different ones and watching numerous YouTube videos, I gave up. I started using my regular curling iron as a wand but the hair would get stuck in the handle and there wasn't as much length since you have the plastic tip of the curling iron as well as the handle. Finally decided to buy a real wand. This one works AMAZINGLY

reviews.t: This is the best hair tool I have ever used
reviews.x: This is the best hair tool I have ever used. I wish I had found these sooner. I love how my hair looks. The girls last a long time. My hair is really straight and normally I can't keep a curl in but these stay in all day. Love it!!!
I must have gotten a lemon. It took over 30 minutes for it to heat up and didn't curl well at all. Very disappointed.

But I cant tell you how much I love it and it was super easy took about 20 mins to do my hair which is almost down to my butt. My husband came home and  couldnt stop telling me how hot I looked the entire night. I Definatly felt beautiful . No compliants even the glove was perfect! And for a first time user i was surprised i didnt even burn myself. I set it on one

I bought an expensive curler all in one from walmart, my wife was so excited when she opened it. Then she tried it and didnt like it. So I bought this curler for her and it works freat and is half the price of walmart curler. I highly reccomend this product becaause it so easy to use that i ead able to curl my wifes hair.

This wand works amazingly! I used the biggest size to curl my hair, shown in the picture. I had absolutely no problems using it. My natural hair is a bit wavy so it curls very easily. Even if my hair wouldn't curl easily, I'd say that this wand would still do the trick. Very happy with this product
Works great.  One barrell did work not but we are getting a new one from company. The company was very accommodating.

reviews.t: Extremely hot, even on lower setting
reviews.x: This iron gets too hot for me to use on my overly dry hair too often. It works well though, but if your hair tends to break , this is not something you want to use daily.  Be very careful using it.  It gets so hot that I burned my arm extremely badly.  I was using the gloves but the iron fell out of my hands and onto the inside of my upper arm and caused the most severe burn I've ever experienced and it took weeks for it to heal.  Even with the gloves, be very careful using this...

This is a really nice set. The set as a whole feels very sturdy. Sometimes with items that you can interchange, it will leave the item feeling wobbly and not secure. However that is not the case with this wand. Also changing the sizes is a snap. Very easy to get apart, and put back together, all you do is squeeze the side buttons and pull apart. I like how it comes with a variety of different sizes to curl your hair with, from tight ringlet style, to loose beach wave curls. It does get pretty ho

reviews.t: Love it and totally worth it.
reviews.x: As a makeup artist, I always have to have my hair done. I have the Sutra curling want but it was always giving me the tightest curls. I was looking for a thicker sized want and ran into this 5 piece set! Totally love it! The only thing I don't like is the piece that supports the wand from touching any surface. It gets tangled in my hair which is annoying at times. But for clients, it's perfect! (: PS doesn't come with gloves or comb.

It took me only 10 minutes to curl all my hair! The wand heated up quickly and I only used it on the 1st setting (setting 1). Be careful not to burn your hand when curling your hair (my wand didn't come with a heat resistant give but Amazon customer service was helpful with rectifying that) as the wand is very hot. I love that I could choose which size barrel to use. I'm so happy with this purchase.

This Item arrived sooner than I expected which is always a great thing it came just in time for a weekend out. I wasn't sure how I'd do with it being that I've never used one before but it was quite simple coming from someone who doesn't really ever get ready. Heats up fast I'm excited to try the other sizes to see the effect it has on my hair. I love that I don't have to fry my hair to get good curls that'll stay in. Really happy customer.

The wand works well for me however i received 2 of the same barrels and then did not receive the smallest taper barrel. I was interested in the bigger barrels anyways so i didnt feel like returning it and rebuying just for that but would have been nice to have anyways.

This iron is great on thin hair that doesn’t require much heat, however I bought it for my daughter who has much thicker hair and it doesn’t curl well at all. Disappointed. If you have thick hair buy something else.

reviews.t: Perfect all in one open barrel curling iron!
reviews.x: MBQ's 5 in 1 curler is exactly what I have been looking for. I wanted an open barrel curler for a while because I think they work much better in my hair. This is perfect because it can be changed to five different type of barrels in one. That alone is a huge money and space saver right off the bat.  I was a little concerned with all the negative reviews I read for this product, but relieved when I didn't have any of the same experiences. Some said some of their barrels didn't heat up, or took to

I absolutely LOVE this curling wand. It gets really hot, really fast. Curling my hair used to take around 90 minutes with a regular curling iron, but with this curling wand it took about 35 minutes to curl all of my hair. The curls were long lasting, and many different styles can be achieved with the different sized attachments. It's simple to use and the heat protecting glove works well, too! All in all I give this 5 stars. My hair looked awesome today thanks to this wand!

reviews.t: I like this. I was hoping to love it but ...
reviews.x: I like this. I was hoping to love it but I just don't. I like the different size barrels. My curls look nice at first but I find with this wand my curls just don't last as long, and I've never been one to struggle with my hair not holding a curl. My conair wand works better, but just doesn't give me the curls I wanted. I may just splurge on a nume someday, but until then, this will do. There are two temperature options, hot and not as hot.

Love the curls and the heat on this curling wand. It's easy to detach the barrels and the heat glove makes so much easier to use. My hair holds a curl whenever I use this to curl my hair and the curls stay all day! For my hair type I did not have to use a spray or any styling products and it worked without it. I would recommend this time. A long cord, different size barrels and a glove. Steal for the price.
Bought my wand about 6 months ago and it's already broken. It doesn't get hot anymore when plugged in and turned on. Very disappointed.
the attachments don't really heat up enough. not happy with the product and now too late to return.
The smallest wand didnt work. cheaply made.

reviews.t: This is a great curling iron.
reviews.x: My first impression of the MQB 5-in-1 Hair Curler is that it is made really well. It heats up almost instantly. The cord is very thick, thicker than usual actually. I love that the wands all have little attached stands so they sit in the correct position. I also love that the power button is recessed into the handle so it can't accidentally be turned off. It does come with a heat resistant glove so you don't burn your hand. The wands go on very easy but come off a bit snug but that could be a go

I bought this for my teenage daughter who has short hair, and is trying to grow it out.  This was the perfect tool for her.  Having short hair for most of her whole life she isn't that familiar with curling hair, and this tool worked great, she loves it.  It works well, warms up fast, and provides some versatility with the different barrels.

reviews.t: I'm disappointed with this product- it arrived and the thinnest wand ...
reviews.x: I'm disappointed with this product- it arrived and the thinnest wand never worked, it failed to heat up when attached properly. Now a month later, after approximately 4 uses, the second smallest wand no longer heats properly. I haven't even tried the rest of the kit and will most likely purchase a new one elsewhere.

reviews.t: Most amazing curling tool I have ever used
reviews.x: Most amazing curling tool I have ever used. I've been using it for about 3 months and I couldn't be happier with it. It took a week or so to get used to the heat glove, but it's a pretty quick to learn. My hair would never hold curl before...with this wand, my waves/curls last until the next day (seriously).

claims.text: Many reviewers love how well it curls their hair and how long the curls last, even on straight hair.
Reviewers frequently praise how easy it is to use, even for first-time wand users.
Several reviewers highlight the interchangeable barrel set as sturdy, convenient, and a good value.
Some reviewers report the wand gets extremely hot and can cause burns, so caution is advised.
A few reviewers had issues with performance or missing/duplicate barrels, though some noted good customer service.
